description: On the crew's first full day in simulation, an EVA successfully retrieved a fuel barrel dropped by the resupply aircraft two days earlier (using ATVs) and refilled water stores from the nearby river.
response: Standard resupply EVA executed without complication.
source_citation: SRC-fmars-c19-2026-mission-updates, sol-1 report: 'We took care of some practical tasks, such as taking our ATV rovers to collect a barrel of fuel from where the airplane dropped us off two days ago and visiting the river to refill our water stores.'
